acceptedBoundaries: Caller complete:true without authoritative anchor returns unknown.
Missing authority anchor returns unknown; no policy/authority assertion is inferred.
Legacy receipt absent keyMaterial returns unsupported.
Producer subset missing authoritative px.image.cropped fails coverage.
Empty pinned authoritative roots and matching producer roots can pass consistency; this does not establish actual query-readable closure.

If both alleged authoritative and producer manifests omit a known query-readable root, consistency passes. This is the documented external authority-completeness boundary; observed subsets and caller pins do not themselves prove authority or completeness.
Exact source bindings and immutable artifact hashes remain required, but hashes do not validate schema or external authority truth.
